title: DeFi total value locked reaches new milestone despite market
content: <div class="tldr-section"><em><strong>TL;DR: While decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms tout new highs in Total Value Locked (TVL), the core infrastructure of truly hard money, Bitcoin, continues its relentless, self-regulating operation, currently at block 935,436 with a robust hashrate of 952.38 EH/s. Transactors must prioritize understanding Bitcoin's unyielding security mechanisms, such as its approaching difficulty adjustment, over the ephemeral metrics of riskier, often centralized, DeFi ventures.
